name: Vandermonde Determinant Obfuscation
description: Replaced the L1-norm absolute value equation with the sum of squared determinants of $3 \times 3$ Vandermonde matrices formed by the sequence values. The determinant $(x-y)(y-z)(z-x)$ is non-zero (and squares to 4) if and only if the three values are exactly $\{1, -1, 0\}$, which corresponds to an edge in the operation graph. This forces models to symbolically expand and factor a determinant to discover the column-wise case analysis, breaking the simple algebraic affordance of the previous equation.
